headline: Woman killed, State Minister Abdul Bari injured in Bogura road accident
summary: A pedestrian woman died and the State Minister for Public Administration and Food was injured when his official vehicle crashed in Bogura.
details: A pedestrian woman named Firoza Bibi died today after being hit by the official vehicle of State Minister Abdul Bari in the Gopinathpur area of Shibganj, Bogura.
The accident occurred on Friday morning on the Joypurhat-Mokamtala regional highway when the driver lost control of the vehicle after the woman stepped in front of the car.
The vehicle subsequently veered off the road and crashed into a nearby paddy field, leaving State Minister Abdul Bari and his wife, Nazma Ara Begum, injured.
The State Minister was initially treated at Joypurhat General Hospital, where doctors found he had soft tissue injuries to his right leg and minor injuries to his hand, shoulder, and neck.
Following initial treatment and a short-leg plaster on his leg, the State Minister was transported to a private hospital in Dhaka for further care.
District Commissioner Al-Mamun Mia confirmed that the Minister departed for Dhaka around 1:00 PM and was unable to attend his scheduled events in Joypurhat due to the accident.
Firoza Bibi, who was reportedly on her way to her daughter's house, passed away while undergoing treatment at the hospital.
caption:
A pedestrian woman has died and a State Minister was injured after an official vehicle crashed in Bogura.

A pedestrian woman named Firoza Bibi died today after being hit by the official vehicle of State Minister Abdul Bari in the Gopinathpur area of Shibganj, Bogura.

The accident occurred on Friday morning on the Joypurhat-Mokamtala regional highway when the driver lost control of the vehicle after the woman stepped in front of the car.

The vehicle subsequently veered off the road and crashed into a nearby paddy field, leaving State Minister Abdul Bari and his wife, Nazma Ara Begum, injured.

The State Minister was initially treated at Joypurhat General Hospital, where doctors found he had soft tissue injuries to his right leg and minor injuries to his hand, shoulder, and neck.

Following initial treatment and a short-leg plaster on his leg, the State Minister was transported to a private hospital in Dhaka for further care.

District Commissioner Al-Mamun Mia confirmed that the Minister departed for Dhaka around 1:00 PM and was unable to attend his scheduled events in Joypurhat due to the accident.

Firoza Bibi, who was reportedly on her way to her daughter's house, passed away while undergoing treatment at the hospital.

headline_marked: Measles outbreak: [[Death toll reaches 987]] as one more dies in 24 hours
headline: Measles outbreak: Death toll reaches 987 as one more dies in 24 hours
summary: Over 1.62 lakh people have been affected by measles and measles-like symptoms across Bangladesh since March 15.
details: One person died within 24 hours (from Thursday 8 AM to Friday 8 AM) due to measles symptoms, according to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
In the same period, 1,154 new cases of suspected and confirmed measles were reported, with 40 of these being confirmed cases.
Since March 15, a total of 888 deaths have occurred due to measles symptoms, while 99 deaths have been confirmed as measles-related.
The combined death toll from confirmed measles and those with measles-like symptoms has reached 987.
The total number of measles-related patients since March 15 stands at 162,262, of which 19,567 have been confirmed cases.
The Health Minister has announced that a nationwide measles vaccination campaign will be launched to combat the outbreak.
